question: Can alignment cost (marginalised over Sobol q0 ICs) serve as an omega-localizer rather than just a filter?
hypothesis: Alignment cost, maximised over q0 ICs per omega-cell, localizes truth-omega.
narrative_md: Decisive NO: alignment cost is a filter, not an omega-localizer. On 2/3 seeds (6, 28) the global-max cell sits at 2x truth-omega-magnitude (a peak-density harmonic artifact where extra peaks let random q0 trivially hit truth peak times); only seed 44 (densest peaks) localizes. Omega localization stays with the LS-bracket (s019, ~5%).
